text: You find the sealed cave dwelling of a cultivator who died long before you were born.

choices.label: Search for what they left behind

outcomes.text: Among the ruin is a manual that still hums with qi.
A guardian formation wakes and flings you out.

choices.label: Leave it. Some graves should stay shut.

outcomes.text: You walk on, a little wiser.
